description: Reviewed decisions for the AWS coverage ledger (specs/spec-aws-core-coverage-ledger.md). service_map: a CloudFormation service whose botocore service the name does not give. type_map: each aws_core entity type and the CloudFormation type(s) it models, or the reason it has none; every model must appear. classification: CloudFormation type -> excluded or not-enumerable with a written reason; a type in neither type_map nor here is unclassified.

aws_core__aws_access_analyzer_finding.reason: A finding the analyzer reports; CloudFormation has no resource type for findings.

aws_core__aws_account_region.reason: The (account, region) footprint the collector derives for containment; not an AWS resource.

aws_core__aws_az.reason: Reference data kept by the catalog refresh skill; availability zones are not a CloudFormation resource.

aws_core__aws_bedrock_model.reason: AWS-owned foundation models; no CloudFormation resource type.

aws_core__aws_delegated_administration.reason: A (member account, service principal) registration, not a resource.

aws_core__aws_ecs_container.reason: A container inside a running task: an embedded detail with no CloudFormation resource.

aws_core__aws_ecs_task.reason: A running task is a transient execution artifact; AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition is a different resource.

aws_core__aws_guardduty_finding.reason: A finding GuardDuty reports; no CloudFormation resource type.

aws_core__aws_policy_statement.reason: One statement of a policy document, not an AWS resource; only the policy can be tagged.

aws_core__aws_region.reason: Reference data kept by the catalog refresh skill; regions are not a CloudFormation resource.

aws_core__aws_securityhub_finding.reason: A finding Security Hub reports; no CloudFormation resource type.

aws_core__aws_tag_policy_rule.reason: One key's entry in a tag policy document, not an AWS resource; only the policy can be tagged.

AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile.citation: botocore 1.43.121 service model iam defines TagInstanceProfile, UntagInstanceProfile and ListInstanceProfileTags, so an instance profile has tags; the CloudFormation schema is silent

AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy.citation: botocore 1.43.121 service model iam defines TagPolicy, UntagPolicy and ListPolicyTags, so a customer managed policy has tags; the manifest collects them with ListPolicyTags

AWS::IAM::SAMLProvider.citation: botocore 1.43.121 service model iam defines TagSAMLProvider, UntagSAMLProvider and ListSAMLProviderTags, and GetSAMLProvider returns Tags, so a SAML provider has tags; the manifest reads them from GetSAMLProvider

AWS::IAM::ServerCertificate.citation: botocore 1.43.121 service model iam defines TagServerCertificate, UntagServerCertificate and ListServerCertificateTags, so a server certificate has tags; the manifest collects them with ListServerCertificateTags

AWS::IAM::VirtualMFADevice.citation: botocore 1.43.121 service model iam defines TagMFADevice, UntagMFADevice and ListMFADeviceTags, so a virtual MFA device has tags; the CloudFormation schema is silent
